omar-sales: Quick checklist request for Acme POC: they need a hosted API key that is inference-only, rotates every 24h, IP allowlist 198.51.100.0/24, and contract-grade audit evidence. Can we give a short ops checklist we can paste into the SOW?

jess-sec: Minimal security requirements: (1) Scoped key (inference-only), (2) Rotation policy (daily), (3) IP allowlist, (4) SEC-PROV ticket before issuing any admin tokens. We prefer customer-run rotation.

liam-devex: Paste-ready ops checklist (short):
1) Sales creates jira:SEC-PROV with POC owner + CIDR.
2) Security approves and either: (A) creates a 7d hosted key via Console OR (B) approves a restricted admin token for programmatic rotation.
3) If programmatic: customer scheduler calls our admin API to create new key, writes to their secret manager, then calls revoke on previous key id.
4) At end of POC, reopen SEC-PROV to request a signed audit export (CSV) for contract.

noah-se: Quick Python rotation snippet for customer (example to include in SOW):
```
# simple rotation sketch
import requests
headers = {"Authorization":"Bearer %ADMIN_TOKEN%","Content-Type":"application/json"}
# create
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys', json={"name":"acme-poc-rotate","scopes":["inference:generate"],"expires_in":86400,"ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.0/24"]}, headers=headers)
new = r.json()['key_id']
# push to secret store (customer infra)
# revoke old
requests.post(f'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/{old_id}/revoke', headers=headers)
```
Note: admin token must be restricted and kept in customer infra.
